meta.title: About PremadeLab — statistics, champion pool and team draft
meta.description: PremadeLab equips a League of Legends team: player lookup, roster, history of games played together, player and team statistics, champion pool per role, composition preparation and post-game review.

shell.footerNote: PremadeLab — stats and theorycraft for your League of Legends team

hero.title: PremadeLab, the tool for your premade
hero.subtitle: Look up a player, build a roster, gather the games you played together, and use them to prepare the next one.

intro.title: What it is for
intro.p1: An amateur team plays together without ever being able to look back at what it played: the game client history is individual, short, and says nothing about what the group does when it is complete. PremadeLab gathers those games in one place and makes them readable at the team level.
intro.p2: PremadeLab is free, with no ads and no paid account. Looking up a player needs no account; building a team does.
intro.p3: Game data comes from the Riot Games API. PremadeLab only reads public games: those of accounts their owners declared, and the latest games of a player someone looks up.

features.title: What the tool does today
features.intro: Nothing beyond this list. Work in progress is not listed here.

roster.title: Build a roster
roster.body: A team is built by adding Riot IDs. Each seat carries its positions — top, jungle, mid, bot, support — and its status: starter, substitute or coach. A player added before he has an account keeps his seat: it reaches him when he signs in and links the same account.

collect.title: Collect the history of games played together
collect.body: Once an account is declared, PremadeLab reads its history through the Riot API and spots the games where the team was present. A game counts for the team as soon as four of its members played it, all queues together.

playerStats.title: Per-player statistics
playerStats.body: By champion, position, queue and month: games, wins, KDA, creep score, gold, damage and vision per minute, along with current rankings. Every figure states how many games and which period it covers.

teamStats.title: Per-team statistics
teamStats.body: The group's record, broken down by queue, by side of the map and by patch, with each member's presence rate and the table of the games played together.

pool.title: Champion pool by position
pool.body: The team declares, role by role, the champions it is ready to field. Under each champion, PremadeLab shows who in that role already played it and at what mastery level, above a floor set by the team.

draft.title: Composition planning
draft.body: A composition holds five champions, one per position, and the player taking each line. It carries the patch it relates to and free-form notes, and is still there for the next game.

reviews.title: Post-game review
reviews.body: From the games table, each member gets a written note attached to that particular game. One note per author, per player and per game; it is edited, never duplicated.

search.title: Look up a player
search.body: A Riot ID is enough: their rank, their top mastery champions, then the stats of their last ten games, collected on demand.

limits.title: What the tool does not do
limits.intro: Said here rather than discovered in use.
limits.history: PremadeLab collects each player's last {{maxGames}} games, from the last {{maxAgeDays}} days at most, or their last {{minGames}} if they rarely play. Older history is not collected.
limits.noWorldStats: No worldwide average: comparisons are made with players of the same tier, from the games PremadeLab collected itself, and every figure says how many games it covers.
limits.noProbe: The page of a looked-up player only shows what Riot makes public: rank, champions and games. Team notes, compositions and reviews stay reserved to team members.
limits.noLive: Nothing live: no in-game tracking, no overlay, no interaction with the game client.
limits.collectTime: The first collection takes time — the Riot API quota limits it. The profile screen says how far along it is.
limits.historyUnknown: PremadeLab only collects each player's recent games: older history is not collected.

access.title: Enter the tool
access.signedInBody: Your account is signed in: the tool is open.
access.signedOutBody: The tool requires an account. Sign-in goes through Discord, then you declare your Riot ID from your profile.
access.ctaProfile: Link my League of Legends account
access.noTeamPermission: Your role does not grant access to teams yet. Personal statistics remain open.

legal.title: Notices
legal.data: What PremadeLab keeps, for how long, and how to request its deletion is described in the privacy policy.

findings.title: Findings
findings.experimentalHint: Measure still being validated: read with care.

behaviour.toWorkHint: The three clearest findings among your weaknesses, ranked by confidence. Each one unfolds on what backs it.
behaviour.actionsHint: Your choices: vision, farming, positioning, presence.
behaviour.consequencesHint: Their effects: laning lead, damage share, results.
behaviour.habitsHint: Your win rate by time of day, in two-hour slots, and right after two losses in a row.
behaviour.nextTierHint: Indicators that grow with rank where you are below the average of the tier above, in your role.
behaviour.nextTierNone: In your role, you already match the tier above on every indicator that follows rank.
behaviour.gap: {{metric}}: {{value}}, versus {{target}} on average in the tier above.
behaviour.unobservable: Wave freezing and fight spacing cannot be read from Riot data: they are not assessed here.

clock.label: Win rate by time of day
clock.timezone: Times in your time zone ({{zone}}). A sector's thickness shows how many games were played then; its colour, whether you win more (green) or less (red) than your average. Light grey: around your average; dark grey: fewer than 3 games.
